mapper.insert: insert into media_recent (owner_key, kind, target_id, album_id, seq, content_hash, pos, dur) select #{ownerKey}, #{kind}, #{targetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{albumId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{contentHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pos,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dur,jdbcType=DECIMAL} from dual where not exists (select 1 from media_recent where )
mapper.update: update media_recent set pos = #{pos,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, dur = #{dur,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, content_hash = coalesce(#{contentHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, content_hash), updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where
mapper.select: select r.kind, coalesce(v.id, r.target_id) as target_id, coalesce(p.album_id, r.album_id) as album_id, coalesce(p.seq, r.seq) as seq, r.pos, r.dur, r.updated_at as happened_at, coalesce(v.title, a.title) as title from media_recent r left join media_video v on r.kind = 'video' and ((r.content_hash is not null and v.content_hash = r.content_hash) or (r.content_hash is null and v.id = r.target_id)) left join media_photo p on r.kind = 'photo' and p.id = (select p2.id from media_photo p2 where (r.content_hash is not null and p2.content_hash = r.content_hash) or (r.content_hash is null and p2.album_id = r.album_id and p2.seq = r.seq) order by p2.album_id asc, p2.seq asc, p2.id asc limit 1) left join media_album a on a.id = coalesce(p.album_id, r.album_id) where r.owner_key = #{ownerKey} and r.kind = #{kind} order by r.updated_at desc, r.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind}
mapper.delete: delete from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind} and id not in (select id from ( select id from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind} order by updated_at desc, id desc limit #{keep}) k)
